projects.name: CareerSphere AI
projects.description: A local-first Career Intelligence & Personal Growth Platform built with AngularJS. Ingests XML, JSON, CSV and resume text, normalizes them into a single career profile, extracts entities, builds a relationship graph and computes skill strength, evidence strength, coverage and career readiness — all rendered through interactive SVG visualizations.

projects.name: ESP32 IoT Agriculture System
projects.description: Developed an ESP32-based IoT agriculture system using LoRa, GPS and sensors to monitor soil moisture and micro-climate across a farm and push readings to a dashboard over MQTT.

projects.name: AI Model Benchmarking Suite
projects.description: Benchmarked classification models (logistic regression, random forest, small neural net) on tabular datasets, tracking accuracy, precision/recall and training time with reproducible Python scripts and Matplotlib reports.

projects.name: Campus Helpdesk API
projects.description: Flask REST API with token auth and MySQL storage for a student helpdesk, consumed by an AngularJS front end. Includes unit tests and Docker packaging.

projects.name: Personal Portfolio Website
projects.description: Responsive portfolio site with dark/light themes.
